clips.title: The story
paras: Sishir Canyon runs east through the Stonetalon Mountains, crowded with Deepmoss spiders. Webs choke the gorge on the dangerous approach to the Ruins of Eldre'thar, where travelers face venomous spiders and their matriarch.

Sishir Canyon cuts through the Stonetalon Mountains toward the ancient Ruins of Eldre'thar. Deepmoss spiders have overrun the gorge, covering its stone floor and walls with sheets of web and clusters of egg sacs. Travelers and sentinels heading for the night elven ruins must fight their way through swarms of aggressive webspinners.

Besseleth lurks in the deepest recess of Sishir Canyon as matriarch of the Deepmoss brood. Her great size and venom make her a danger to anyone trying to secure the pass. Local forces in Stonetalon keep watch and warn travelers that the webbed depths hold more than scattered spiders: Besseleth fiercely guards her brood.
